theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_fc_cauchy_subseq
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ η : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < η → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ j, ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ X j - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ η) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ X (φ (r + 1)) - X (φ r) - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
